a.xlink:title: Takes the files that changed. Nothing happens while a run uses the model.
Takes the values of this file into the units that are linked to it.
Pending edits have to be taken into the model before the linker compares the model with a file.
Watches exactly the linked files and the folders that hold them.
The train unit with this id, or null. The pointer points into the model.
The status of a link, or a link itself, has changed.
A message for the status line, shown for milliseconds.
The path for a UTF-8 name. Text that cannot be converted as UTF-8 is read in the system code page,...
Reads the whole file at path into content, byte for byte. Returns false when the file cannot be opene...
